name: Craven Drok
summary: In Orgrimmar, Craven Drok keeps to the Cleft of Shadow and seeks travelers for a delicate matter. He wants them to consider how the Alliance sees the Horde.

sections.title: A Skulker in the Shadows
sections.body: Craven Drok avoids Orgrimmar's sunlit avenues and wanders the winding paths beneath the city. The Cleft of Shadow draws warlocks, rogues, and practitioners of less honorable trades. Drok keeps out of sight and hires passersby to handle discreet errands, including one about the Horde's standing with the Alliance.

faq.q: Where can I find Craven Drok?
faq.answer: Craven Drok wanders the underground paths of the Cleft of Shadow, beneath Orgrimmar's main thoroughfares.
Craven Drok earns his name by skulking in dark caverns and keeping his head down. He hires others to handle tasks he would rather avoid, against orcish ideals of bravery and martial glory.

faq.q: What is his involvement with the Alliance?
faq.answer: Craven Drok begins Alliance Relations by praising Thrall's wisdom and knowledge of human ways. He sends travelers to Keldran, who works to keep the Alliance from wrongly believing the Horde has made pacts with the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Who does Craven Drok send travelers to?
faq.answer: Craven Drok sends travelers to Keldran, a student of magic whose hovel lies near Orgrimmar's western exit. With the Warchief's blessing, Keldran works to keep the Horde from being mistaken for an ally of the Burning Legion.

angles.text: As an orc, you may see Craven Drok's habit of lurking in the Cleft of Shadow as a mark against the honor and courage your people prize.
As a rogue, you may find the Cleft of Shadow familiar ground, where those who work out of sight gather and make contacts like Drok.
